verdict.rationale: Pulumi offers building blocks for autonomous automation—the Automation API for programmatic, CLI-less runs, an MCP server enabling AI assistants to query/act on stacks and delegate to Neo, and Neo itself described as taking plain-English instructions and executing changes autonomously—plus confirmed headless CLI operation (preview/up/destroy without human interaction). However, Neo's autonomous execution claims are vendor-only with no independent/community evidence, and no evidence of built-in scheduling/triggering for unattended background runs (e.g., cron-like automation) beyond what a user must wire up externally.
